fc149bdda052a23ffe9a6a7bae0d8f71d08a8a5f.summary: This is a project README for godoh, a proof-of-concept command-and-control framework written in Go that uses DNS-over-HTTPS as its transport. It describes installation, build steps, command-line usage and a GPL v3 license. It is a software project page rather than a threat report, so it records no actors, incidents, CVEs or other threat facts.
